notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 21 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer2921cont), the 27 weekly issues from 2 July to 31 December 1921. Same method as the later volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1920-1923, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1921. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 139 of the 217 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out (where the crop shows only the heading, only the heading is published; where an entry runs over a page break the next page was read too). Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note; scrub_owner.py removes the fragments the OCR garbles past the first cut); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor, architect or engineer named is the owner or shares the owner's surname that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates are set from the dated running heads, 27 issues one week apart with no gap. Permits whose heading counts more than one dwelling (31) were set aside before the image check and sit with the held single houses, as do four single houses that were read against the image and have no architect left to name. Five held rows whose parcel has a page were read against the image and published.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 21 part 2 to 31 read (July 1921 to January 1932); the 13 half-year volumes before July 1921 (1915 to June 1921) are unread, vol. 21 part 1 (January-June 1921, buildingengineer21119cont) next. In this volume: 178 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, single houses with no architect named and no page (31 of them permits for a row of houses), are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; all but four still need the image check). 365 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 794 rows were not placed: location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), street pairs that do not cross under the names read, and printed street numbers with no EAS row today.
coverage.note: 3,117 numbered entries read, 1,553 San Francisco rows, 759 placed on a parcel, 217 picked and read against the page image, 165 published on 151 pages (82 seeded), 51 held back: twenty-seven uses, storeys or unit counts that contradict the roll, nineteen alterations with nothing to confirm the street number, two pieces of minor work, one Oakland address, one unreadable entry and one repeat listing; four more joined the held houses.
